body_md:
## SSC CGL 2026

Staff Selection Commission invites online applications for the Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026.

### Posts

- Assistant Section Officer
- Inspector (Central Excise)
- Assistant Audit Officer
- And more...

### How to Apply

1. Visit the official SSC website
2. Register with your details
3. Fill the application form
4. Upload documents
5. Pay application fee
6. Submit and print confirmation

guides.title: Eligibility Criteria
guides.body_md:
### Age Limit

18-32 years (relaxations as per government norms)

### Educational Qualification

Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.

guides.title: How to Apply
guides.body_md:
1. Visit ssc.nic.in
2. Click on 'Apply' link
3. Register with email and mobile
4. Fill the application form
5. Upload photo and signature
6. Pay fee online
7. Submit form
8. Take printout
